name: Citadel, Ancient City and Fortress Buildings of Derbent
description: In Dagestan, on the Caspian coast, Derbent grew up between two long stone walls that once ran from the sea up into the mountains. Sasanian Persia built them to guard the narrow pass along its northern frontier. Visitors can walk the fortress, the citadel and streets that keep part of their medieval layout, in a city that stayed strategically important until the 19th century.
